caption: The drawing is done in pencil on a light tan or beige background and features a central depiction of a fireplace screen with two andirons. The screen has a rounded, double-arched top with a stepped border and appears to be made of a single solid panel. Flanking the screen are two andirons, each with a twisted vertical shaft, a diamond-shaped top section, and a bulbous, ornate base that includes a diamond motif. The bases of the andirons extend forward into three legs each, with the front two forming elaborate S-shaped curves ending in small, flat circular feet. At the bottom foreground of the drawing, there is a long, narrow, and slightly tapered metal bar with engraved designs and an angled end, possibly a tool or part of the fireplace apparatus. In the upper left and upper right corners, there are two detailed inset diagrams showing the side and top profiles of components, both annotated with precise measurements in inches. The objects are shaded to suggest three-dimensional form but are entirely in grayscale. The name "Ludmila Calderon" appears written in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Andirons and Fireback
